subject: GhostShift procurement: blended-rate bridge & regional SKU alignment
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@ghostshift.com>, procurement@ghostshift.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: blended-rate bridge + SKUs for multi-region deployment

Hi Carla and team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the clarity on GhostShift's usage profile (burst to 1.8M tokens/day, regional failover needs). Attached is a concise offer that addresses three asks you called out:

1) A blended per-token rate that matches incumbent total cost-to-serve for first 12 months (we propose a two-tier blended bridge).
2) A simplified regional SKU mapping so billing is predictable across US-East, US-West and EU-West.
3) A migration credit to offset one-time infra/integration work (applied as a one-time invoice credit).

High level summary (details in attached redwood-pricing-bridge.csv and regional_sku_matrix.xlsx):
- 12-month blended bridge: $0.00095 per token effective for first 12 months (covers generation + embeddings).
- Migration credit: $75k one-time credit applied at kickoff.
- Regional SKU uplift: US-East baseline, US-West +6%, EU-West +12% (to reflect egress and cross-region peering).
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pools; production support included.

We built the numbers to be cash-flow-neutral vs your incumbent in year one while giving you better latency and an ops runbook for failover. If you want, I can produce a1-page TCO that compares Redwood to the incumbent across CPU/GPU egress and reserved capacity.

Next steps: please confirm which contract vehicle you prefer (standard MSA vs procurement PO + SOW) and whether the procurement team wants the redlined SOW today. I can loop in Marissa to fast-track legal.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0121

Attachments: redwood-pricing-bridge.csv, regional_sku_matrix.xlsx
From: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@ghostshift.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ghostshift.com, Diane Holt <diane.holt@procura.co>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: blended-rate bridge + SKUs for multi-region deployment

Hi Logan,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the transparent numbers. A few clarifying points from procurement and our engineering lead:

- The incumbent is offering a 12-month effective rate of $0.00088/token once you include their storage/egress rebates. Can you bridge that exactly or do we require a different concession structure?
- We have an on-prem pilot requirement for one cluster (air-gapped). Need to understand packaging/one-time fees for an on-prem license vs Pure Hosted.
- Migration credit looks reasonable but procurement wants the credit split: 50% applied at kickoff, 50% tied to go-live acceptance criteria.

Diane (procurement consultant) recommends we get a clean comparison table (line-by-line: per-token, reserved capacity, egress, support, migration support) and a fallback SLA credit if performance misses the SLA for more than two weeks post-cutover.

If you can restructure the bridge to get within $0.00001/token of incumbent effective rate (or provide an alternative that nets to the same spend), we can get to legal review quickly. Also please include a clear on-prem fee line in the SOW.

Best,
Carla
VP, Platform & Ops | GhostShift
carla.mendez@ghostshift.com

--
Carla Mendez
GhostShift
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: counter-proposal framework for GhostShift (notes + price table)

Logan — capturing recommended concession structure and talking points to thread into our response to Carla. Kept it tight so sales/legal can plug numbers into SOW.

1) Price bridge options (pick one):
  A) Pure per-token match: drop bridge to $0.00088/token (loss-leading on token margin; offset with 12-month commit and 6-month prepay).
  B) Blended + credit: keep $0.00095/token but increase migration credit to $95k and offer a 3% quarterly usage rebate if they exceed volume thresholds (reduces effective rate).
  C) Hybrid reserved: offer 20% of expected peak reserved at locked discounted rate plus blended on-demand at $0.00090/token.

2) On-prem packaging: one-time license + provisioning fee = $40k (includes on-site onboarding and air-gap packaging). Also offer extended support at $9k/month for the pilot window.

3) SLA fallbacks: if latency objective or availability missed >14 days, provide service credit equal to 5% monthly invoice for affected month.

4) Procurement ask (credit split): agree to 50/50 split but tie second 50% to defined go-live checklist (integration smoke tests + KV cache performance baseline).

5) Negotiation play: lead with Option B in external reply (higher upfront credit, preserves unit economics) and reserve Option A as escalation concession if they push price match in legal.

Attachments: suggested_quote_table (I pasted numbers below):
- Option A: $0.00088/token; Migration credit $75k; prepay 6 months required
- Option B: $0.00095/token; Migration credit $95k; 3% usage rebate over thresholds; no prepay
- Option C: Reserved 20% @ $0.00070/token + on-demand $0.00090/token; Migration credit $60k

Logan — I recommend Option B as our public offer and keep Option A in pocket for PO negotiations. Marissa: can you confirm legal timeline to redline SOW (we may need a fast-track 48h review)?

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Manager, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@ghostshift.com>, procurement@ghostshift.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: blended-rate bridge + SKUs for multi-region deployment

Carla — thanks for the candid ask and the incumbent number. We want this to be an easy win for GhostShift so here's our revised, executable offer (we'll turn it into a clean SOW and DocuSign link once you confirm):

Official offer (Option B - public):
- Blended per-token: $0.00095/token for months 1–12
- Additional migration credit: increased to $95,000 (50% at kickoff, 50% on go-live acceptance)
- Usage rebate: 3% quarterly rebate applied if monthly tokens exceed the volume threshold in the attached CSV (brings effective rate within ~0.00001 of incumbent at planned volumes)
- On-prem pilot: one-time packaging/provisioning fee $40,000; pilot support $9,000/mo (optional line item)
- Regional SKUs: US-West +6%, EU-West +12% (unchanged)
- SLA credit: 5% monthly invoice credit if availability SLA missed >14 consecutive days in production

Why this matters: keeps predictable monthly spend, reduces your migration runway risk, and preserves our ability to recommend quantization/kv-cache adjustments post-cutover to drive unit-costs lower. Karthik has the escalation option (Option A) if procurement pushes the exact per-token match in redlines.

Next steps: If you confirm the public offer I will:
- Generate a redlined SOW including the on-prem fee line and credit split
- Send DocuSign for signature (link below)
- Schedule kickoff with our Solutions team for pre-cutover runbook the week after signature

DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.net/DocuSign/Signing/12345-GhostShift-Offer
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/489203/DEAL-2027-0419-GS

If you'd like to talk through tradeoffs live I can set up 30 mins tomorrow morning with Karthik and Marissa.

Best,
Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: GhostShift_SOW_v2.pdf, redwood-pricing-bridge.csv
